children: Asian equity markets declined on Monday as hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh revived expectations for a US rate hike in September.
In his Jackson Hole address on Friday, Warsh warned that inflation isn’t meaningfully slowing and reaffirmed policymakers’ commitment to returning inflation to their 2% target.
Sentiment was also weighed down by a jump in oil prices after the US military targeted Iranian rocket launchers preparing to deploy mines into the Strait of Hormuz.
Tech-heavy equity benchmarks in Japan and South Korea led the declines, while shares in China and Hong Kong also moved lower.

title: Asian Stocks Drop on Hawkish Fed Bets
